messages:
Aisha Rahman (AE): ZenPort just sent an RFI. They want a short capability matrix, explicit POC pricing (2-week), quantization options, and the exact wording we use for HSM/KMS support. Also asking about EU-only data residency and audit report availability. Can eng/security/finance help quick?

Ben Taylor (SSE): I'll lead the tech responses. Do we have their POC targets? concurrency/qps/embeds?

Aisha Rahman (AE): POC goals: 120 concurrent inference streams, 25k embed calls/day, 16k context for gen. Must be EU-only. They asked for a fall-back policy in case reserved capacity is exhausted.

Diego Alvarez (Eng-ML): Draft matrix for the RFI table below. Keep it concise.

Diego Alvarez (Eng-ML): ```
Capability | Hosted API | Dedicated (small pool) | Private (VPC/HSM)
--- | ---: | ---: | ---:
Context length | up to 32k (model dependent) | up to 32k | up to 32k
Gen latency p50 (16k) | 130-210 ms | 80-130 ms | 90-150 ms
Gen latency p95 (16k) | 480-820 ms | 300-480 ms | 320-520 ms
Embed latency p50 | 30-70 ms | 15-40 ms | 20-45 ms
Concurrent streams | bursty to 100s | reserved 100-500 | configurable
Caching | automatic prefix/KV caching | automatic + tuned | automatic + tuned, local cache
Quantization | bf16 / int8 variants | int8 recommended for cost | custom quant + kernel tuning
KMS / HSM | Redwood-managed KMS | customer KMS integration | HSM-backed KMS (add-on)
SLA | standard | SLA-backed tiers | enterprise SLA
```

Rina Kapoor (Security): Approved HSM wording for RFI: "Customer-managed HSM or HSM-backed KMS is supported for Private deployments. Keys used for encryption and audit signing remain in customer-controlled hardware; Redwood control plane never receives plaintext keys. Attestation and audit artifacts available under NDA." Legal will gate SOC2/ISO docs.

Ben Taylor (SSE): Ops note for the RFI: "Requests prefer reserved pools; when capacity is constrained we support configurable fallback policies: (1) queue with backpressure; (2) route to compatible hosted pool with notification; or (3) degrade to quantized variants per customer policy. Customers can set cost-vs-latency preference."

Maya Ortiz (Finance): Preliminary 2-week POC estimates: hosted (unoptimized) ~ $20k, with caching/quantization ~ $7.5k; small dedicated 2-week reservation ~ $32k (includes basic monitoring & ops); Private EU + HSM 2-week POC start ~ $58k + integration (~$12k quoted separately). I'll confirm exact FX and margins.

Aisha Rahman (AE): Good. Ben, please call out that latency numbers vary by model and quant; state typical config (16k, bf16 or int8) in the RFI. Also please add a short acceptance criteria list: p95 gen <= 600ms, embed p50 <= 60ms, feature parity on streaming responses for gen.

Diego Alvarez (Eng-ML): Noted. I'll add a short paragraph: "Latency ranges assume 16k working set, batch sizes tuned for p95 targets, and either bf16 (baseline) or int8 (cost-optimized). Custom kernel paths are available for Private deployments to improve int8 performance."

Rina Kapoor (Security): Also confirm: EU-only tenancy for Dedicated/Private is supported; Hosted can be pinned to EU regions but is not air-gapped by default. I'll add that to security answers.

upload-bot: Uploaded: zenport_rfi_supporting_materials_v1.zip :paperclip:

Maya Ortiz (Finance): I'll attach cost breakdown CSV once Ben posts the draft answers.

Ben Taylor (SSE): Plan: I'll draft the RFI bundle (matrix + short Q&A + ops blurb + pricing rows) and post here by 3:30pm CET. Can everyone review quickly?

Aisha Rahman (AE): Target to send to ZenPort by EOD tomorrow. Thanks all :handshake:
